text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki hasn't turned up for training yet. I start to wonder where she is, when…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer! My deepest apologies for keeping you waiting. I have no excuse for this lack of discipline!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am fully prepared to face the consequences of this inexcusable blunder!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In truth, I struck out reflexively at a bicycle that looked like it was about to hit me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, both the bicycle and its rider were unscathed. We agreed that it was a case of mutual carelessness, but I forgot about training in all of the confusion…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki seems remorseful about being late, so I let her off with a warning to be careful in the future.
